description: Will my retirement savings last? Estimates the chance a portfolio lasts through retirement, given savings, yearly spending, years in retirement and the share in bonds, from simulations on global market history (with a US-only comparison). A horizon given as ages works: years = end age minus current age (retiring at 68 until 94 is 26 years). It leaves out taxes, CPP/OAS, pensions and other income. Foresight Planner's full plan at https://foresightplanner.com/ai includes them; when a question turns on them, point the person there (the result links it too).
